completion_data.completion_summary: Landed the paper's relational truth transport TruthCorr with a single six-case induction truthAt_of_truthCorr, and derived TimeShift.timeShift_preserves_truth, IntTransfer.truthAt_map, and truthAt_of_truthIso from it with byte-identical statements, deleting their hand-written inductions (truth-transport inductions 5 -> 3, no HEq, no Equiv on WorldHistory, no sorry, axioms unchanged). Re-pinned specs/paper-definitions-of-record.md so check-paper-definitions.sh exits 0, replaced raw-line-number paper citations with \label citations, corrected the atom-clause and convex docstrings, and updated the stale H_F quotes.

memory_candidates.content: When a Lean truth-transport lemma must hold on arbitrary (partial) histories but the paper's proof only uses existence of related total histories in both directions, package the transport as a Prop-valued relation structure (relation on arbitrary histories + atomic agreement on related pairs + totality-existence fwd/bwd) rather than an Equiv on the history type: the box case only needs existence, and an Equiv on a structure with a dependent states field forces HEq. TruthCorr in FormalSystem/Semantics/Truth.lean is the worked instance; TruthIso, time shift, and IntTransfer's Aligned are all instances.

Do not run a lake env lean axiom check concurrently with a full lake build in the same .lake tree: it produced a spurious 'no such file or directory' .olean write failure mid-build. Serialize them; re-running the build recovers. Also: the lake-build-guard wrapper needs the lake subcommand repeated after '--' (guard build --timeout N -- build Module.Name).

reflection.what_worked: Porting the verified experiment verbatim first and only then adapting binders; every derivation compiled on the first scoped build. Running #print axioms against the still-HEAD .olean before rebuilding gave the 'before' profile for free.
reflection.what_was_hard: Background-build completion notifications did not arrive twice, stalling the dispatch; switching to foreground builds with a 600s timeout fixed it.
reflection.what_was_missed: The plan's H_F grep pattern was shell-escaped into an end-of-line anchor; had to re-derive the sweep by hand.
reflection.successes: All six phases closed with statements byte-identical, five hand-written inductions reduced to three, and the paper-definitions lint restored to green.
